summary: Creates a city for a player at a plot and returns its id pair.
usage: local pid, cid = mgr:Create(ePlayer, x, y)  or  mgr:Create(ePlayer, plot)

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

returns: 2 numbers (owner PlayerID, CityID) on success; nothing if fewer than 2 args, invalid plot, or manager returned id -1
side_effects: Manager::Create constructs CommandCreate and adds it to Command::Manager (recorded).
cautions: Wrapper returns nothing (no error) on bad args or failed creation; no check here that plot is free/valid. Player is read via tonumber so nil/strings probably become 0.

summary: Adds a building to a city (with construction percent, optional plot) and reports success and requirement results.
usage: local ok, results = mgr:CreateBuilding(city, eBuilding, uiConstructionPercent [, plot | x, y])

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

args.name: uiConstructionPercent
args.meaning: Construction percent (100 in known mod usage)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: Optional location passed to the manager
args.form: optional plot object or x, y at arg positions 5 (and 6)

returns: 2 values: boolean success, and a requirements-results object (PushRequirementsResults)
side_effects: Manager::CreateBuilding builds CommandCreateBuilding, calls Initialize/Apply, then Command::Manager::Add.
cautions: If the city is invalid nothing is attempted but it still returns false plus an empty results object. Plot defaults to invalid (-9999,-9999) when omitted. Always check the first return.

summary: Adds a district to a city (construction percent, optional plot) and reports success and requirement results.
usage: local ok, results = mgr:CreateDistrict(city, eDistrict, uiConstructionPercent [, plot | x, y])

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

args.name: plot
args.form: optional plot object or x, y at arg positions 5 (and 6)

returns: 2 values: boolean success, and requirements-results object
cautions: A district needs a plot; an omitted plot stays (-9999,-9999) and probably fails. Invalid city returns false without acting.

summary: Returns the City object for a (playerID, cityID) pair.
cautions: Only works with exactly 3 stack values (self + 2 args); any other arg count returns nothing. Returns nothing if either id is -1 or the city is not found. Object is an editable City::Instance (EditCity).

summary: Reads a WorldBuilder value of a city (by value type id) and returns it to Lua.

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

args.name: name
args.form: string or number (read via tolstring); used only when a 4th arg of those types is present

returns: 1 value (converted from the stored ValueEntry variant); nothing if city invalid
cautions: Returns nothing for an invalid city. Unknown value types probably yield a default entry (FindValueHandler lookup); not verified.

summary: Reads a WorldBuilder value of a district and returns it to Lua.

args.name: district
args.form: District object (GetDistrictID helper not decompiled; probably also an id table)

returns: 1 value; nothing if district id invalid
cautions: Returns nothing for an invalid district.

summary: Returns which city owns a plot as a table.
usage: local t = mgr:GetPlotOwner(plot)  or  mgr:GetPlotOwner(x, y);  t.PlayerID, t.CityID

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

returns: 1 value: table {PlayerID=, CityID=}, or nil if out of bounds / unowned / bad args
cautions: Always returns exactly one value (nil when no owner). Reads the map plot directly.

summary: Removes a city.

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

side_effects: Manager::Remove builds CommandRemove and adds it to Command::Manager.
cautions: Silent no-op if no arg or city id invalid.

summary: Removes all cities of a player, in one command block.
side_effects: Command::Manager::StartBlock/EndBlock around per-city CommandRemove, so probably one undo step.
cautions: Does nothing if called without the argument; a non-number arg probably becomes player 0 (tonumber default), unverified.

summary: Removes the city located on a plot.

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

side_effects: Looks up the city at the plot (EditCityAt) then City::Manager::Remove -> CommandRemove.
cautions: Silent no-op if no plot arg, bad plot or no city there. Signature marks it static but the plot still starts at argument position 2.

summary: Removes a building from a city.

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

returns: 1 boolean (manager result; false for invalid city)
cautions: Check the return value; false when city invalid, and probably when the building is absent.

summary: Removes a district, given either a district object or city plus district type.

args.name: district or city
args.meaning: With 2 stack values (self + 1): a District object (or cached district); with 3 or more: a city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

args.name: eDistrict
args.meaning: District type (only in the city form)

returns: 1 boolean, which in this wrapper is always false
cautions: Return value is hard-coded false (the manager bool is discarded); do not use it to detect success. Silent no-op for invalid ids.
evidence: lRemoveDistrict 0x5eee90; City::Manager::RemoveDistrict (0x607d90); wrapper stores 0 into the result slot

summary: Sets a WorldBuilder value (by type id) on a city.

args.name: city
args.form: city object or table {PlayerID=,CityID=} (GetCityID helper not decompiled; accepted forms probably these)

args.name: value
args.form: number (stored as integer-typed variant); anything else goes through the string path

side_effects: FindValueHandler is looked up (the value-change handler runs engine side, not read).
cautions: Booleans are not handled specially (string path, probably wrong); use 1/0. Call data shows no Command constructed, so probably not undoable. Silent no-op for invalid city.

summary: Sets a WorldBuilder value on a district.

args.name: value
args.form: boolean (boolean variant), number (integer variant) or string

side_effects: None seen beyond value handler dispatch in the manager.
cautions: No Command in call data, so probably not undoable. Silent no-op for invalid district. Booleans are handled here (unlike SetCityValue).

summary: Assigns a plot to a city, or clears ownership.
usage: mgr:SetPlotOwner(plot|x,y, city)  or  mgr:SetPlotOwner(plot|x,y, false)  or  mgr:SetPlotOwner(plot|x,y)

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: city
args.meaning: New owner city; boolean or absent clears
args.form: city object/table, or false; omitted also clears

cautions: A boolean or missing owner arg gives city id (-1,-1) meaning unowned. Silent no-op if plot args invalid. A nil (non-boolean) arg goes to GetCityID, behaviour unknown.

summary: Creates a unit of a type for an owner at a plot and returns its id pair.
usage: local pid, uid = mgr:Create(eUnitType, ePlayer, x, y)  or  mgr:Create(eUnitType, ePlayer, plot)

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

returns: 2 numbers (owner PlayerID, UnitID); nothing on bad args or failure
side_effects: Manager::Create constructs Unit::CommandCreate and adds it to Command::Manager.
cautions: Arg order inferred from Manager::Create(eUnit, eOwner, loc); the earlier recovered name eOwner for position 2 looks swapped (decompiler parameter mapping is garbled), so medium confidence. Needs more than 3 stack values or returns nothing.

summary: Removes a unit.

args.name: unit
args.form: unit object or id table (GetUnitID helper not decompiled)

cautions: Silent no-op if no arg or invalid id.

summary: Removes all units of a player, in one command block.
cautions: No-op without the arg; a non-number arg probably becomes player 0 (unverified).

summary: Removes units standing on a plot.

args.name: plot
args.form: plot object, or two numbers x, y (IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Decompile is partly mislabelled (a call named Cache::City::Growth::GetAmenitiesLostFromBankruptcy is probably a unit count at the plot); it iterates unit slots at the plot and removes the first valid unit of each index. Probably removes all units on the plot; unverified.

summary: Looks up a map configuration value entry in WorldBuilder::Configuration::Manager and pushes its stored value to Lua.

args.name: name
args.meaning: optional extra string key; used only if stack slot 2 is a number/string, then read from slot 4

returns: 1 value (the ValueEntry's stored variant converted by the script system)
cautions: Code reads the type from stack slot 1 (the object itself on a colon call) while SetMapValue reads slot 2; this looks inconsistent, so the type argument may be ignored or misread (probably a game bug; untested). Optional-name slot logic is odd (slot 2 tested, slot 4 read).

summary: Returns a table with the current map settings: Width, Height, IsWrapX, IsWrapY, plus MapScript and Ruleset when set.
returns: 1 table {Width, Height, IsWrapX, IsWrapY, MapScript?, Ruleset?}
cautions: MapScript key present only if Configuration::Map::Instance::GetScript succeeds; Ruleset only if non-null. Read-only snapshot.

summary: Stores a map configuration value (number as integer variant, otherwise string) under a value-type key via WorldBuilder::Configuration::Manager.

args.name: value
args.meaning: new value; numbers truncated to unsigned int, anything else converted to string

side_effects: Dispatches through Map::Manager::FindValueHandler (a handler lookup); handler behavior not visible.
cautions: Does nothing if the value argument is missing (needs at least 2 args after self). Numeric values are truncated to integers; no validation in the wrapper. Undo not visible in callee data (no Command seen), but handler is not readable.

summary: Asks the terrain builder whether a feature can be placed on a plot.
usage: mgr:CanPlaceFeature(x, y, feature [, params|bool]) or mgr:CanPlaceFeature(plot, feature [, params|bool])

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: feature
args.meaning: feature type, or a table of feature parameters (parsed by IMapTerrainBuilder::GetFeatureParameters)

args.name: options
args.meaning: optional extra: table or boolean forwarded as check options

cautions: Returns false (no error) when too few args, plot cannot be parsed, plot is outside map bounds or feature param is -1. Read-only check.

summary: Asks the improvement builder whether an improvement can be placed on a plot.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: flag
args.meaning: optional boolean forwarded to CanHaveImprovement (meaning not visible)

cautions: Wrapper requires at least 3 args after self (it passes 3 to the plot helper), so the plot-object form needs a further arg or it returns false. Plot pointer not null-checked in wrapper.

summary: Asks the resource builder whether a resource can be placed on a plot.
usage: mgr:CanPlaceResource(x, y, resource [, flag]) or mgr:CanPlaceResource(plot, resource)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: flag
args.meaning: optional boolean forwarded to CanHaveResource (meaning not visible)

cautions: Form guessed from arg count: exactly 2 args after self is parsed as plot,resource; 3+ as x,y,resource,flag. So plot,resource,flag is read as x,y form. Returns false with <2 args.

summary: Returns whether the plot borders a river (WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::DoesPlotBorderRiver).

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Returns false if the plot cannot be parsed.

summary: Adds or removes a cliff on a plot edge in the given direction through WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::EditCliff.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: bAdd
args.meaning: boolean passed as first param to the cliff command (probably add vs remove)

cautions: Returns false when args are missing (needs 3+ after self) or plot unparsable. Recorded as CommandEditCliff via Command::Manager::Do.

summary: Adds or removes a river segment on a plot edge through WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::EditRiver, returning success and a result code.
usage: local ok, code = mgr:EditRiver(x, y, direction, bAdd [, flag])

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

returns: 2 values: boolean (true when result code == 0), number (IResultCode)
side_effects: Validation via CommandEditRiver::CanAddRiver and Rivers::SplitsRiverFromMouth before the command.
cautions: On bad args returns false, 0. Non-zero code means the edit was refused; code meanings not decoded.

summary: Returns the plot indices belonging to a continent (land plots and lakes, excluding other water).

args.name: continentIndex
args.meaning: continent index compared with each plot's continent field; read with tonumber (no hash/name lookup)

returns: 1 table (array of 0-based plot indices) or nil
cautions: Returns nil unless exactly one argument is given and it is a number. Table is empty if the continent has none.

summary: Reads width and height attributes of the root <map> element of the Tiled XML file set as map import filename.
returns: 2 numbers (width, height); defaults 64 and 48 when the file/attributes cannot be read
side_effects: Loads and parses the XML file.
cautions: Always returns two numbers; failure is silent and yields the 64x48 defaults, so verify the file yourself.

summary: Returns a list of plots (numbers) related to placing a feature at a plot, from the terrain builder.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: feature
args.meaning: feature type; if not a parameter table it is read with luaL_checkinteger, so a number is required (no name/hash)

returns: 1 table of numbers (probably plot indices, inference) or nothing
cautions: Registered as static (no instance check). Returns nothing when plot is invalid or list is empty. luaL_checkinteger raises a Lua error on a non-number feature.

summary: Returns a stored per-plot value entry (value type, optional name) from WorldBuilder::Map::Manager.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: plot parsed by IMapPlot::GetPlotIndex starting at slot 2

args.name: valueType
args.meaning: value type key; fixed at stack slot 3

args.name: name
args.meaning: optional key name at slot 4, used only if number/string

returns: 1 value (variant converted by script system) or nothing if plot arg invalid
cautions: Type is read from fixed slot 3, so an x,y plot form would misplace it. Returns nothing on bad plot.

summary: Checks resource-definition data: true if the resource has valid-feature entries (own list non-empty, or a Resource_ValidFeature row matches its type name).

args.name: resourceType
args.meaning: index into the resource definitions, via GetNumberOrHash (slot 2)

cautions: Despite the name the code reads Resource definitions, not improvements; the intent is a guess (probably 'resource needs a feature'). Static; false on missing arg or unknown index.

summary: Returns true when a plot is too close to another natural wonder for the given feature (inverse of NaturalWonderDistanceCheck).

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot given as ONE argument; wrapper tells the helper only 1 arg remains
args.form: plot object or index (x,y form probably not accepted - inference)

cautions: False if args missing, plot not found, or plot null. Pass a plot object/index.

summary: Loads the Tiled (.tmx XML) map file named by the map import filename and places terrain/feature/resource/improvement/continent/district/building layers onto the map's plots.
side_effects: Resets the map via FillScratchMap and rewrites plots with PlaceTileOnPlot; handles CSV and per-tile XML layers.
cautions: Fails silently (map filled/reset, no error) if the file or <map> root is bad. Visible calls use Context::Globals::EditMap directly, not WorldBuilder commands, so it is probably not undoable. Rewrites the whole map.
evidence: lLoadPlotsFromTiled 0x5f38d0; Context::Globals::EditMap, FillScratchMap, PlaceTileOnPlot; call data lists no Command (list may be truncated)

summary: Reveals or hides the whole map for a player, grouped as one command block.
cautions: Returns false unless both args given. No player validation in wrapper.

summary: Adds a coastal lowland (flood) type to a plot directly through the terrain manager's CoastalLowlandDataHandler.
usage: mgr:SetCoastalLowland(x, y, lowlandType) or mgr:SetCoastalLowland(plot, lowlandType)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Return value is constant false even on success. Plot index computed as width*y+x without bounds check. No undo command.

summary: Sets a plot's continent via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetContinent.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot given as ONE argument; wrapper tells the helper only 1 arg remains
args.form: plot object or index (x,y form probably not accepted - inference)

cautions: False when args missing/plot unparsable. Recorded via Do<CommandSetTerrain> (probably terrain unchanged, continent set).

summary: Sets (or changes) the feature on a plot via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetFeature.
usage: mgr:SetFeatureType(x, y, feature [, params|bool]) or mgr:SetFeatureType(plot, feature ...)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: feature
args.meaning: feature type, or params table (IMapTerrainBuilder::GetFeatureParameters); params fill feature and a direction value

cautions: Feature and direction default to -1 when not given. -1 as feature probably clears it (guess). Validity checks are inside Manager::SetFeature (not read).

summary: Sets the pillaged state of the improvement on a plot directly via the improvement builder.
usage: mgr:SetImprovementPillaged(x, y, bPillaged) or mgr:SetImprovementPillaged(plot, bPillaged)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Always returns false even on success; no WorldBuilder command, so not undoable. Plot-vs-x,y form is guessed from arg count (exactly 2 args after self = plot,bool).

summary: Sets the improvement on a plot (optionally with owner player) via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetImprovement.
usage: mgr:SetImprovementType(x, y, improvement [, player]) or mgr:SetImprovementType(plot, improvement)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Arg-count heuristic: exactly 2 args after self = plot,improvement; 3+ = x,y,improvement,player, so plot,improvement,player is read as x,y form.

summary: Stores a per-plot value entry (type, optional name, integer or string value) through WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetPlotValue.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: plot parsed by IMapPlot::GetPlotIndex from slot 2

args.name: valueType
args.meaning: value type key at fixed slot 3

args.name: name
args.meaning: optional name; present only if 4 args are given

cautions: Silent no-op when plot arg unparsable. Number values truncated to int. Undo not visible in callee data.

summary: Sets the resource (with amount) on a plot via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetResource.
usage: mgr:SetResourceType(x, y, resource [, amount]) or mgr:SetResourceType(plot, resource)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Arg-count heuristic as other Set* methods. Placement validity not checked in wrapper; use CanPlaceResource first.

summary: Reveals or hides one plot for a player via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetRevealed.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

cautions: Needs 3+ args after self; wrapper tells plot helper 2 args remain, so x,y form is probably required (inference).

summary: Sets the route on a plot via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetRoute.
usage: mgr:SetRouteType(x, y, route [, flag]) or mgr:SetRouteType(plot, route)

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot: x,y pair, or a plot object/index (parsed by Cache::Lua::Utility::GetPlotLocation)

args.name: flag
args.meaning: optional boolean passed to SetRoute (meaning not visible, probably pillaged)

cautions: Arg-count heuristic: plot,route,flag is read as x,y form.

summary: Sets the terrain of a plot via WorldBuilder::Map::Manager::SetTerrain, and removes the plot's resource if it no longer fits the new terrain.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot given as ONE argument; wrapper tells the helper only 1 arg remains
args.form: plot object or index (x,y form probably not accepted - inference)

side_effects: Callee data shows EditRiver and EditCliff invoked inside SetTerrain (probably clears rivers/cliffs); after success wrapper calls CanHaveResource and SetResource(-1,0) if the resource no longer fits.
cautions: Several commands are issued for one call. Only the plot-object form is parsed (helper told 1 arg).
evidence: lSetTerrainType 0x5f58a0; Map::Manager::SetTerrain -> Do<CommandSetTerrain>, EditRiver, EditCliff; Map::Resource::Builder::CanHaveResource; SetResource

summary: Returns the Nth (key, string) pair of the mod's localization table for a locale.

args.meaning: 1-based position in the locale's pair list

args.name: locale
args.meaning: optional locale name, default current game language

returns: 2 values (key, text; nil for a null pointer) or nothing
cautions: Returns nothing if index < 1, locale not found or index past the end.

summary: Returns the locale name at the 1-based index in the mod manager's language list.
cautions: Nothing returned for index < 1 or past the end.

summary: Returns the localized string stored for a key in a locale.
cautions: Nothing if key missing/not found.

summary: Removes a key from a locale's localization pairs.
cautions: Needs at least 1 arg. No Command seen in callee data (not undoable).

summary: Replaces the key and string of the Nth entry in a locale's localization table.
cautions: False unless 3+ args and index >= 1. Not undoable per callee data.

summary: Adds a (key, text) pair to the mod's localization table for a locale.
cautions: False unless 2+ args. Whether it overwrites an existing key is not visible. No undo command.

summary: Adds a new player slot via WorldBuilder::Player::Manager::AddPlayer and returns its player id.

args.name: flag
args.meaning: false/nil gives false, any other value true; meaning inside AddPlayer not decoded (probably major vs minor)

returns: 1 number: new player id, or -1 if the argument count is not exactly one
side_effects: Call data: Player::Manager::AddPlayer calls Player::Manager::InitializePlayer (which for the Lua InitializePlayer records CommandInitialize). Whether AddPlayer itself is undoable was not decoded.
cautions: Wrapper returns -1 without acting when called with no argument or with 2+ arguments. No self check (ScopedInstance::GetInstance not called).

summary: Clears the start position assigned to a given player.

args.name: playerID
args.meaning: player whose start position is cleared

cautions: Silent no-op when called without the argument. Player id not range-checked in the wrapper.

summary: Clears whatever start position (player/leader/civ/random) is set on the given plot.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot location, parsed by IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation
args.form: plot location args (probably x,y pair or plot object/index; exact forms not decoded)

cautions: Silent no-op if no args or the plot location cannot be parsed. No feedback whether a start position existed.

summary: Returns the constant maximum player count.
cautions: Hard-coded constant, does not query game config.

summary: Returns a table describing a player slot's configuration (name, slot status, civ, leader, era, gold, faith).
returns: 1 value: table with Name, SlotStatus, IsHuman, IsFullCiv, IsCityState, IsBarbarian, IsFreeCities, Civ, Leader, CivLevel, Era, Gold, Faith; or nil on bad argument
side_effects: Reads Configuration::Player::Instance and Player::Manager::Edit; localization lookup for the name.
cautions: Returns nil unless exactly one numeric arg and id < 64. IsHuman is SlotStatus==3. Civ/Leader/CivLevel/Era may be nil. Gold/Faith are 0 if the player is not initialized (fixed-point >>8, whole units). Name falls back to localized text plus id+1 without a civ definition.

summary: Returns the configured slot status number of a player slot.
returns: 1 number: SlotStatus enum value; returns 2 when arg missing, not a number, or id >= 64
cautions: Fallback value 2 on bad input is indistinguishable from a real status 2. Enum meanings not decoded (GetPlayerConfig treats 3 as human).

summary: Describes the start position marker on a plot, if any.

args.name: plot
args.meaning: target plot location, parsed by IMapPlot::GetPlotLocation
args.form: plot location args (probably x,y pair or plot object/index; exact forms not decoded)

summary: Returns the player id whose start position is on the given plot.

args.form: plot location args (probably x,y pair or plot object/index; exact forms not decoded)

returns: 1 number: player id, or -1 if no player start there, bad args or out of map
cautions: -1 is also returned if the plot holds a leader/civ/random start (only the Player kind is reported).

summary: Probably: WorldBuilder::Manager owns a Command::Manager (at +0x1f0) holding eastl lists of shared_ptr<Command::Instance>. Lua StartUndoBlock/EndUndoBlock call Command::Manager::StartBlock/EndBlock, which probably create and close a BlockCommand (it has Add/Undo/Redo/CanUndo/CanRedo/GetName/GetType) so that commands passed to Manager::Add inside the block are grouped as one undo step. Edit code uses Command::Manager::Do<CommandX,...> templates (CommandSetTerrain, SetFeature, SetResource, SetImprovement, SetRoute, EditRiver, EditCliff, SetRevealed, SetStartPos), which probably construct a command, add it and run its Redo. Undo/Redo take commands from the list and call their Undo/Redo; classes include Create/Remove/Initialize/Uninitialize (+ building/district variants with Apply) and property setters (Civic, Era, Faith, Gold, Tech, Leader, PlotOwner). Lua only sees CanUndo/CanRedo and boolean results of Undo/Redo.
cautions: Manager-level setters (SetID, SetMod, SetWBAdvancedMode, visibility preview) are plain setters, not commands. Behaviour of EndBlock without StartBlock, nested blocks, and Undo while a block is open was not read; keep Start/End balanced. Class details are inferred from names only.
